definitions: A type of confectionery made from sugar, butter, and milk or cream, cooked until it turns a golden-brown colour.
A light brown colour, typical of caramel.
Sugar that has been heated until it liquefies and turns brown, used as a flavouring or colouring in food.
examples: She bought a bag of soft caramels.
The paint was a rich caramel colour.
Add a spoonful of caramel to the sauce.
